script.title: Look, No Wings!
script.description: A great white pelican balances on a scarlet bicycle, with one wing raised, an enormous golden bill and orange webbed feet working the pedals. Open spoked wheels, smooth white wings, black flight feathers and a hanging throat pouch define the silhouette.
